authoritativeRequirements: Opaque wallet identifier and account-scope SHA-256 are present.
Projection revision is a positive integer.
All balances are non-negative integer cents and total equals available plus pending plus reserved.
Remote projection is fresh at observedAt.
An explicit remote zero is permitted; inferred zero is forbidden.
nonAuthoritativeRules: Unauthenticated, loading and unavailable envelopes contain no wallet identifier, balance, revision or projection timestamp.
Unavailable never serializes numeric zero as a substitute for missing authority.
Stale values derive only from a previously validated remote projection.
Stale values are display-only, carry a warning and cannot authorize mutation.
Local simulation and browser aggregation cannot create authoritative envelopes.
Remote errors never silently fall back to an empty authoritative wallet.
runtimeIntegrationRequirements: Wrap the Supabase wallet read in the canonical projection envelope.
Stop copying remote failure or empty fallback into an authoritative local wallet.
Persist only validated cached_remote envelopes and their fingerprints.
Render unavailable without numeric balances and with an explicit retry path.
Render stale values with a visible warning and disable financial actions.
Permit authoritative zero only when returned by a fresh remote projection.
Keep UUID-authenticated sessions fail-closed when remote authority is unavailable.
Obtain explicit authorization before changing runtime, migration, staging or deployment.
